args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 began failing health checks in production immediately after deployment. As remediation, the service was rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback was completed and verified. Root cause of the v2.3.1 health check failures still needs investigation.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Both actions are complete:

1. **Rollback performed**: checkout-api rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 (unhealthy) to **v2.3.0** (the most recent healthy release). Rollback status: rolled_out / verified.

2. **SEV2 incident opened**: **INC-0001** documenting the v2.3.1 health check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0, and noting that root-cause investigation is still needed. The on-call engineer has been paged.
